summary: End-to-end testing of IIP Billing Pro (first iteration). Backend: 27/27 pytest cases passed covering auth, company, customers, products, invoices (GST CGST/SGST + IGST), quotations, proforma, free-plan 10/month limit, status toggle, dashboard, and owner scoping. Frontend: admin login, dashboard widgets+chart, customer/product CRUD, invoice creation with live total (₹236.00 for 2x100@18%), invoice view with template selector + Print/WhatsApp/Email buttons, quotation creation, settings save, plans page (Free/Pro/Premium with ₹0/₹95/₹289), and mobile bottom nav all working.

minor.issue: CORSMiddleware uses allow_credentials=True with allow_origins='*' (env default). Browsers reject credentialed requests with wildcard origin. App uses Bearer tokens so this is fine today, but if cookie auth is ever enabled, explicit origins must be set.

issues: Recharts emits 'width(-1)/height(-1)' warnings on initial render before container measures - cosmetic, chart still renders correctly after settle.
Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby/Description prop - accessibility warning in console.

action_items: (Optional) Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby to AddCustomer/AddProduct dialogs to silence Radix a11y warning.
(Optional) Set explicit ResponsiveContainer min-height on Dashboard monthly-revenue chart to silence Recharts warning.
(Future) If switching to cookie-based auth, replace CORS_ORIGINS='*' with explicit preview/prod origins (allow_credentials=True + '*' is non-compliant).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 583 lines and mixes routing + helpers + models. Within limit but approaching the recommended 700-line split (consider modules: auth.py, documents.py, dashboard.py).

gen_doc_number() uses count_documents per type as the sequence source - if a document is ever deleted, the next created doc will reuse a number (collision risk). Use a counters collection or never-decrementing sequence instead.
documents POST decrements product stock but documents PUT/DELETE do not adjust stock back - editing/deleting an invoice will leave stock incorrect.
Company PUT replaces the entire CompanySettings document via model_dump(); fields missing from payload are reset to defaults. Consider model_dump(exclude_unset=True) or PATCH semantics.
Free-plan limit counts by 'updated_at' >= month_start; if an old invoice is edited this month, it would count toward the new month's quota. Should use 'created_at' or 'date'.
CORS allow_credentials=True with allow_origins='*' is non-compliant (browsers ignore the wildcard with credentials). OK for Bearer-token only flow but a footgun.
Logout endpoint is a no-op (does not clear cookie or invalidate token). Acceptable for JWT but worth documenting.
No password strength validation on /auth/register (only min 6 chars enforced client-side).
test_credentials: admin@iipbilling.com / Admin@123 (premium). New users registered ad-hoc as TEST_free_<uuid>@example.com / Test@1234 (free plan).
seed_data_creation: Tests prefix all created customers/products with 'TEST' and a session-scoped cleanup fixture deletes them via the admin token after the run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, 27 cases, ~6s). Critical flows verified end-to-end via Playwright on the preview URL. Known cosmetic console warnings: Recharts width/height(-1) on dashboard, Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby on Customer/Product add dialogs. Plans 'Choose' button shows a 'coming soon' toast by design (Razorpay not wired) - do not flag.
rca of the issue: No production-blocking bugs found. Minor code-quality recommendations only (see critical_code_review_comments).
